sources.selection: Layer 9: FTYPE=460 river/stream areas. Layer 12: FTYPE=390 lake/pond and AREASQKM>=0.03. Service envelope intersection, then exact geographic display clipping.
sources.limitations: Mixed feature dates; the download/refresh date is not a single observation date. Not a survey of current water levels. Lakes below 0.03 km² (~7.4 acres), reservoirs, swamps and line-only water features are outside the displayed lake/area selection. Lake/pond class does not imply oxbow origin.

sources.publisher: U.S. Army, Mississippi River Commission; scan hosted by Michigan State University Libraries
sources.title: Lower Mississippi River: Early Stream Channels at Approximate Half-Century Intervals, Sheet 5, Mile 258 to Mile 331
sources.version: Prepared August 1938; engineering reproduction imprint 1939. URL filename includes 1927, but the cartographic title block identifies 1938.
sources.license: Original U.S. federal government map is public domain in the United States. A faithful scan is reproduced with archive credit; no exclusive rights claimed over source map.
sources.resolution: Scanned raster map; PDF page 1398.96 × 1609.68 points. Original scale of miles retained in complete PDF; no original projection inferred.
sources.coverage: Lower Mississippi near Helena, Arkansas, and adjacent Mississippi, one sheet of a twelve-sheet set.
sources.legend: 1765 Ross; 1820–1830 U.S. Land Office; 1820–1830 indeterminate bankline (dashed pink); 1881–1893 and 1930–1932 Mississippi River Commission surveys.
sources.limitations: Historical compilation from multiple surveys. Crops retain original colors, geometry and orientation. Not georeferenced to NHD; crops at separate scales. No rates of migration, exact cutoff dates, present-day conditions or complete reconstructed time slices inferred.
